controls.evidence: The canonical Spark registry identifies 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4 as SPARK_PROXY. Deployment-to-block-26110183 Rely/Deny census and current getters resolve the vault's only active event-enumerated ward as SPARK_PROXY (deployer 0xd1236a6a111879d9862f8374ba15344b6b233fbd revoked). SPARK_PROXY has three active wards: DSPauseProxy 0xbe8e3e3618f7474f8cb1d074a26affef007e98fb, StarGuard 0x6605aa120fe8b656482903e7757babf56947e45e and ESM 0x09e05ff6142f2f9de8b6b65855a1d56b6cfe4c58. ESM source can deny the governance proxy, not call exec or upgrade this vault. StarGuard's complete Rely/Deny census leaves only DSPauseProxy authorized; spellData is empty. DSPauseProxy.owner() is DSPause 0xbe286431454714f511008713973d3b053a2d38f3, whose owner is zero, delay is 172800 seconds and authority is Chief 0x929d9a1435662357f54adcf64dcee4d6b867a6f9 (hat 0xf01b594af26fc8a8ae1e24dcaf904ecb6fd1badc). Verified Chief canCall permits only the elected hat; DSPause enforces scheduled execution. Delegatecall target selection and changes to wards or delay remain governance powers, not immutable bounds. This is a current role census, not an execution-complete certificate or independent-human/key-custody claim.

review.evidence: Reviewed exact native vault source, unchanged getImplementation()=0xf943cb8d5f06f2bbf352878ebef3ec5c537a20ba and deployment-to-pin authorization events through Ethereum block 26110183. The only active event-enumerated vault ward is Spark SPARK_PROXY. Its DSPauseProxy and StarGuard execution paths converge on the current Chief-authorized DSPause with 172800-second scheduling; the third ESM ward has only revocation access, not vault-upgrade execution. This closes the prior unidentified ward/controller inventory. Governance retains arbitrary delegatecall payload selection and can change wards or the delay through authorized execution; no immutable cap, independent signer identity, key-custody assurance or execution-complete narrowing is claimed. Parent mint authority remains inherited.
